xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4290: Ended agent sessions should show their outcome (Merged, Review approved, Stopped by close-out) instead of a bare "Session ended"

plan.title: Ended agent sessions should show their outcome (Merged, Review approved, Stopped by close-out) instead of a bare "Session ended"
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Every agent session whose terminal is gone shows 'Session ended', whether it finished normally (reviewer verdict, merged PR, close-out) or crashed, so the operator cannot tell a normal finish from a failure. In addition, normalizeAgentStatus maps a review row's changes-requested and a test row's failure to 'error', so ended specialist rows render red as if they crashed.
narratives.Proposal: One pure render-time derivation (src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/sessionOutcome.ts) maps facts already in the dashboard store — derived issue state (PR review decision, checks, merged, issue state), the agent snapshot (status, stoppedByUser), and SessionNode fields (planningComplete, reviewer round verdict) — to an outcome label and a quiet/attention tone via a first-match precedence table where PR-derived outcomes rank first. Store-reading hooks feed AgentStepRow, SessionPanel and DrawerAgentSession; the two unmounted surfaces route through the shared fallback. A small contract extension (optional DerivedPrState.merged, emitOnly) keeps 'Merged' derivable after close-out. docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md documents the labels.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do not read the pipeline journal in the outcome derivation
- Do not consult the test agent's uat.verdict; the test outcome comes from pr.checks
- Do not add a persisted status field or a server-side outcome field on SessionNode; do not change routes/projects.ts or routes/command-deck.ts node builders
- Do not change normalizeAgentStatus or live-row status rendering
- Do not change describeAgentStop in AgentPillPopoverRow.tsx or StoppedAgentsBanner
- Do not delete or re-mount ConversationTerminal, TerminalPanel, or TerminalSessionWrapper
- Do not add new colors, tokens, or badges; normal outcomes (including Merged) stay muted, never --success
- No new endpoint, polling loop, query, or store slice

autoDecisions.summary: Derive the outcome in the frontend from store facts, not as a server-side SessionNode field
autoDecisions.rationale: The store already holds derived issue state and agent snapshots, and the drawer works from SessionAgent, so a server field would touch four builders and still need a frontend path for the drawer.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not read the pipeline journal
autoDecisions.rationale: Its review verdicts are already on the PR (self-review marker comments are read back into reviewState), merge is covered by the new pr.merged flag, the journal dies with the workspace at close-out, and the PR wins on disagreement.

autoDecisions.summary: Add optional DerivedPrState.merged (set only when true)
autoDecisions.rationale: deriveState ranks closed above merged and the pr object omits the merged flag, so after close-out 'Merged' would be underivable; the field is derived and emitOnly, not a persisted status, and omitting it when false keeps existing fixtures unchanged.

autoDecisions.summary: 'Ended unexpectedly' requires positive evidence: recorded error status, ended while still recorded running/starting, or a primary plan/work/strike agent that ended with no outcome on a known-open, unmerged issue
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator's complaint is false alarms; synthesized Review/Test rows exist whenever a PR exists and carry PR-derived statuses, so treating 'no match' as unexpected for them would re-create the problem. Missing facts produce the plain 'Session ended' fallback, matching AC-1.
It is the same fact the Test row's own status already comes from and is available on every surface, including the drawer.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the two unmounted surfaces and route them through the shared fallback helper
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists them explicitly; the surgical-change rule forbids deleting unrelated dead code; conversations carry no pipeline facts, so the fallback is the correct label there.

autoDecisions.summary: All normal outcomes and the fallback render with --muted-foreground; only 'Ended unexpectedly' uses the existing error treatment
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the style guide's quiet treatment for normal outcomes, and the style guide allows at most one colored signal per row.

autoDecisions.summary: Workers and paused agents never reach the primary-agent 'Ended unexpectedly' rule
autoDecisions.rationale: Worker sessions are pushed as type 'work' nodes and a machine pause leaves status 'stopped' without stoppedByUser; both are normal states (PausedBanner already surfaces pauses), so labelling them unexpected would be a false alarm.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. Add `merged: Schema.optional(Schema.Boolean)` to DerivedPrState in packages/contracts/src/derived-issue-state.ts (after `mergeable`, doc comment 'Present only when true; survives state: closed (PAN-4290)'). At both fact-assembly sites in src/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state.ts (grep `pr: { url: pr.url, number: pr.number` — lines ~731 and ~857) append `...(pr.merged ? { merged: true } : {})` inside the pr object so open-PR payloads are byte-identical to today. Add a round-trip case with pr.merged:true to packages/contracts/src/types.test.ts and, in tests/unit/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state.test.ts, a closed-issue + merged-PR case (state 'closed', pr.merged true) and an open-PR case whose pr has no merged key. This is a derived emitOnly wire field, not a persisted status.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/sessionOutcome.ts exporting exactly the types and functions listed in PRD WI-2 (SessionOutcomeKind, SessionOutcomeTone, SessionOutcome, SessionOutcomeRole, SessionOutcomeFacts, SESSION_ENDED_FALLBACK, deriveSessionOutcome, outcomeFactsFromSessionNode, outcomeFactsFromAgent). Implement the 12-row precedence table verbatim (first match wins; labels, details, tones as written; only 'ended-unexpectedly' has tone 'attention'). Implement the adapter rules verbatim, including: a node whose agent snapshot has role 'worker' maps to role 'worker' before the node.type mapping (worker sessions arrive as type 'work' nodes); `paused` comes from the agent snapshot and row 11 requires paused !== true; synthesized = node.type review|test; legacy node maps to role plan with synthesized true; recordedStatus from AgentSnapshot first, else node.status only for non-synthesized agent-backed node types; drawer review agents with id /-review-[a-z]+$/i map to 'reviewer'; drawer planning finalized per decision D6. Pure module: no store, no React. Write src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/sessionOutcome.test.ts with one case per precedence row plus the named edge cases in PRD WI-2, and append 'src/lib/sessionOutcome.test.ts' to the root package.json test:frontend-subset script.
